The '''All Terrain Construction Transport (AT-CT)''' was an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] variant designed specifically for construction purposes.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:All_Terrain_Construction_Transport.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The pod of an AT-CT]] Based on the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], it sported two legs. the AT-CT was equipped with small but powerful [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] generators used to lift large building materials for construction-related tasks. All other weapons and extraneous systems had to be discarded to focus on this system, but the tractor beam was usable as a weapon. It could pick up heavy items and throw them at enemies. They were often piloted by experienced [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] for maximum efficiency.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==History==
At least one AT-CT was stationed on the [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]], and when [[Kota's Militia]] [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|invaded]], the AT-CT was used against the militia. The walker was destroyed by [[Galen Marek]] as he ventured through the facility to confront [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. Many AT-CTs were used while creating the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] for carrying parts of metal and supplies. Marek destroyed another AT-CT while onboard the Death Star, in search for the captive leaders of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the PSP, PS2, and Wii versions of this game, the AT-CT was replaced by the AT-ST variant, and unlike the AT-CT battle, where it was controlled by the Empire, the AT-ST was taken over by an insurgent by jumping on top of the AT-ST, opening the hatch, blasting its original pilot, and throwing the pilot's dead body out.
